data.narrative:
SirenOpt is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jared O'Leary, Ali Mesbah, and Joel Paulson. The company has raised $19.0M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector encompasses 9 private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and 1 public comparable.

Stage-Progression methodology is applicable here. Using total raised ($19M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next funding stage yields an implied valuation of $48M. This method is grounded in observed progression patterns across early-stage venture capital rounds.

Peer-Median analysis is not applicable. While 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, insufficient data density prevents reliable triangulation—only 1 same-stage peer was identified, falling short of the minimum 3-point threshold needed to establish a credible median. Using the broader sector median would introduce material noise given the heterogeneity of the peer set.

The triangulated valuation range is $40M (low) to $55M (high), with a median of $48M. This range reflects conservative downside and upside bounds around the stage-progression output. Key uncertainties include the absence of a robust near-peer set for direct comparison and reliance on a single methodology. Capital efficiency, technical differentiation, and market traction would refine this range materially if disclosed.
